verdict.score_rationale: This lands at the 6 anchor because the operational map is legible and deliberately structured, but large dead bands, uneven density, and exposed routing machinery keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The three main stages and lower lifecycle region establish a broad composition, but the very large empty band above them and substantial unused space within the right stage make the frame feel underfilled.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal agents, blue memory, yellow human/event elements, gray process infrastructure, and red exception paths are mostly semantically consistent and legible, though the large yellow notes carry disproportionate visual weight.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: The concurrent-review fan-out exposes shared vertical routing rails and ambiguous wire merges, while the long dashed blue and red feedback loops read more like routing apparatus than polished flow.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Reviewer icons and core process boxes hold useful local registers, but oversized notes, widely varying gaps, and sparse stretches between regions disrupt the overall rhythm and hierarchy.
